change_summary: Adds opt-in CBB read-only grade reconciliation adapter and paper-card confidence overlay with workflow regressions. Nov 18 32 delivered rows reconcile correctly; VMI/NJIT/UNC uppercase-leading tokens remain intact. Five-star EV-derived ratings are suppressed in new presentation overlays as unvalidated, with legacy score retained for audit. Private operative grader and Wave 3 renderer not yet wired. Does not change v5 or POWER_V1/Lane A probability/price logic, historic cards, existing graded results, risk gates, or bet eligibility.
assumptions: The private operative_tools/grade_card.py and actual Wave 3 graphic emitter are not in this public repo and require separate integration; this PR does not claim that nightly grading/graphics have been patched.
Row-list reproduction from the user-uploaded Nov 18 report establishes arithmetic, not provider-authenticated odds or original wagers.
EV-derived five stars do not constitute independently calibrated prediction confidence and are suppressed on the new overlay until future acceptance evidence is established.
An optional simple two-sided no-vig diagnostic is not POWER_V1 de-vig methodology nor the separate uncertified v2.1 30/70 risk rule.
No real approved betting stakes, official counted results, forward calibration improvement or source authentication are asserted.
The pre-existing frozen standalone CBB model digest drift remains an unrelated real CI blocker and must never be repinned or suppressed silently.

baseline.metric: Five-star confidence and nightly-grade row grouping
